req.title: List returns empty array when db empty
req.statement: The system shall return an empty JSON array on GET /tasks/ when no tasks exist.
triggers: list returns empty array when db empty

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-033 requires GET /tasks/ to return an empty JSON array with HTTP 2xx when no tasks exist. Three tests are designed: (1) positive EP test confirming exact 200 status and [] body on a clean DB; (2) negative NEG test confirming a client error (invalid query param) yields 4xx, not 2xx; (3) boundary BVA test confirming skip=0&limit=1 (minimum valid limit) still returns [] and exact 200 on empty DB, catching off-by-one mutations on the limit/skip guards. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite in-memory DB injected via dependency override to guarantee isolation.

tests.name: test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_200_and_empty_array
actions: Override get_db dependency with a fresh in-memory SQLite session
Send GET /tasks/ with no query parameters
expected: Response body is exactly the JSON array []

tests.executable:
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_mem = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionMem = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem)

def override_get_db():
    db = SessionMem()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_list_tasks_empty_db_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == []
    assert "application/json" in r.headers["content-type"]

app.dependency_overrides.clear()

Response body is NOT an empty array

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_mem2 = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionMem2 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem2)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem2)

def override_get_db2():
    db = SessionMem2()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db2
client2 = TestClient(app)

def test_list_tasks_invalid_skip_param_returns_422():
    r = client2.get("/tasks/?skip=-1")
    assert r.status_code == 422
    body = r.json()
    assert body != []
    assert "detail" in body

app.dependency_overrides.clear()

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db, Base

engine_mem3 = create_engine("sqlite:///:memory:", connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
SessionMem3 = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine_mem3)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine_mem3)

def override_get_db3():
    db = SessionMem3()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db3
client3 = TestClient(app)

def test_list_tasks_empty_db_min_limit_returns_200_and_empty_array():
    r_valid = client3.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=1")
    assert r_valid.status_code == 200
    assert r_valid.json() == []
    r_invalid = client3.get("/tasks/?skip=0&limit=0")
    assert r_invalid.status_code == 422
    assert r_invalid.json() != []

app.dependency_overrides.clear()
